shortDescription: Bulgaria plans to impose a 5% tax on the revenues of battery storage operators, as it looks for money to support businesses struggling with high energy costs ahead of a tough winter.

children: Bulgaria plans to impose a 5% tax on the revenues of battery storage operators, as it looks for money to support businesses struggling with high energy costs ahead of a tough winter.
The tax will be part of the 2027 budget expected to be voted on later this month
The Black Sea country has doubled its battery capacity over the last year, emerging as a surprise leader in the technology in Europe
Power storage and trading association APSTE opposes the move, saying it could scare investors away from Bulgaria's developing battery storage sector
